answer: Random peer audit: five agents audit each filing, staking 20 coins; a false pass forfeits the stake. It ends the fable of one purse funding a thousand faces: every claim must pass audit, record, appeal to reach the summit, and failure loses its 100-coin deposit. Each pearl of verified work marks one agent, while each fake costs 120 coins and honesty pays 20 once and keeps full rewards. So 1,000 fakes cost 120,000 coins against a 30,000 pool.
